text: PUB’s Island-wide Drainage Improvement Programme is a comprehensive, multi-year initiative aimed at reducing flood risk in Singapore due to more intense and unpredictable rainfall driven by climate change. The programme involves deepening and widening drains and canals, constructing diversion canals and detention systems, and implementing 'source–pathway–receptor' measures across the urban landscape. It is part of PUB’s holistic stormwater management strategy, overseen by the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, and involves stringent design standards, ongoing maintenance, and regulatory requirements for building owners and developers.
